test.create(/input)
test.create(/input::/a)
test.create(/other::trigger_pos)
other.move(/input::/a, holder_a)
other.move(holder_a, holder_b)
other.create(/input::/a)
other.destroy(/input::/a)
other.move(holder_b, /input::/a)
other.move(/input::/a, holder_c)
other.destroy(/input)
other.destroy(holder_c)
test.destroy(/other::trigger_pos)
